title: Rescue line lite · Level 1: Smooth line
brief: A 4 x 3-tile course of 300 mm tiles (a black line about 19 mm wide on white), laid by the simulator's map builder from the library's tiles: the Start tile, three straights, seven round corners (#44, radius 150 mm) and the Goal tile, a ring through all 12 cells opened between the Start and the Goal, 2.85 m of line. The robot starts on the Start tile on the line, facing along it, moved up to 10 mm sideways and turned up to 5 degrees (run 1 too). The robot is the class robot (Configure robot's default: four downward colour sensors 24 and 48 mm ahead, 16 mm either side); a run on a changed robot is not this level's. The RCJ referee judges the run: a tile is reached in order (5.4.6), and a lack of progress is called when the robot passes the next tile's exit off the line (5.5.1b) or takes a wrong line (5.5.1c); the robot is then put back on the Start tile and the start button pressed for it. A run ends when the robot reaches the Goal tile, at the third lack of progress, or after 90 s. Score: 60 x the fraction of the line completed (the progress along it, never past the tiles reached in order and the robot's front), + 20 x min(1, par / time) if it reached the Goal, + 20 if no lack of progress was called. Par 18.1 s (the P-only reference's mean). Pass: a mean of at least 60 over the 5 runs, and at least 4 of 5 runs reach the Goal.

score.run: 60 * fraction + if(goal, 20 * min(1, par / goalTime), 0) + if(lops == 0, 20, 0)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

pass: sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true) >= 60 & count(r in runs: r.goal) >= 0.8 * n
